name: AVSpeech: Large-Scale Audio-Visual Speech Separation Dataset
description: AVSpeech is a large-scale audio-visual dataset designed for active speaker detection, speech enhancement, and audio-visual speech separation (the 'Looking to Listen' cocktail party problem). Curated by Google Research, it contains approximately 2.4 million video segments spanning roughly 4,700 hours of speech drawn from 292,000 YouTube videos (270k train, 22k test) featuring over 150,000 unique human speakers without background music or overlapping speech interference.
